summary: Military aircraft, including fast jets, carry out high energy manoeuvres within 15 nautical miles of Loch Luichart, Monday to Thursday, up to 24,500 ft.
text:
MIL ACFT, INCLUDING FAST JETS, WILL CONDUCT HIGH ENERGY MANOEVRES
WI 15NM RADIUS OF 573620N 0044528W (LOCH LUICHART). ACFT MAY BE
UNABLE TO COMPLY WITH RAC. FOR INFO 01343 817218. AR-2026-11231/01.
